_comment: WHICH APKS RUN IS *NOT* HERE -- it is APK_NAMES / NUM_APKS at the top of
scripts/run_experiment.py, so that choice lives in exactly one place.
run_feature_eval is OFF by design: LLM scoring is offline post-processing and
must not sit inside a per-app budget. Inline, one TestCube eval took 6h24m and
turned a 1-hour app into 7.5 hours. Score afterwards with scripts/score_features.py,
which is the only way both tools get identical parameters anyway.
